messages.subject: Pennington - Project Forge: counsel call moved
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, James,

Note the con-call with counsel on the Pennington Industries matter (Project Forge) has moved to Tuesday 14 January at 3pm. Catherine Rosenthal KC's clerk has confirmed. Nothing needed from you before then - just diary it.

Donna
